Messages.Author: MaciTitular
Messages.Body:
Can you use a Spiritual Guidance...

A vampire can play only one Spiritual Guidance each combat.Play a combat card from your ash heap as if from your hand. If that card would be burned, instead remove it from the game.

...to play a Increased Strength that you have just played in the same combat? And before the range of the same combat round?

Only usable before range is determined. For the remainder of combat, all damaging strikes that require Potence made by this vampire inflict +1 damage. As above, but those strikes inflict +2 damage.

Thanks

Messages.Author: gatocion
Messages.Body:
What about the following, stated in the outline overviwe:

For strike cards
Pay cost.
Wait until strike resolution to resolve. (VI.C.2)
The strike card is "in limbo" until it is put in play or sent to the ash heap (or removed from play) at resolution. [RTR]

The Increased Strength, that has just been played, wouldn't it be in the limbo, and therefore not available as a target for the Spiritual Guidance?

Thanks for the clarification.

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body: Limbo is only for action cards played from hand, all other cards are played either to the ash heap or put in play... this is not to be confused with the fact that both actions and strikes have a delayed resolution, but only actions have a delayed payment of cost.

Messages.Author: the1andonlime
Messages.Body:
> gatocion wrote:
> Limbo just applies for action, strike, action modifier cards and reaction cards?
>
Action cards - go to "limbo" when played

Strike cards - go to ash heap when played (unless card text explicitly says otherwise)
Action Modifier cards - go to ash heap when played (unless card text explicitly says otherwise)
Reaction cards - go to ash heap when played (unless card text explicitly says otherwise)
